title: GOV-01 static toolchain acquisition pending approval envelope v2 (draft)
description: Strict pre-execution public envelope. External preapproval validation occurs before the user approves the exact raw envelope digest and challenge. Runtime performs bound-schema hash checks plus manual critical-field enforcement before any write or verifier-source compilation. The envelope freezes public artifacts, executor/verifier bytes, keyed private-state commitments, locator-free content-addressed toolchain identities, source/USTAR/resolution/final-tree receipts, exact execution and mutation ceilings, and private-state authority. It contains no post-success PASS claim and no raw private locator or private-state digest.

census_at_utc.description: Canonical UTC seconds; its date is bound to approval_challenge_id. At validation it may be historical but must not be more than five minutes in the future.

not_after_utc.description: Must be later than validation time and census_at_utc, with a maximum TTL of 24 hours from census_at_utc.
